digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center adapter and reconciliation engine
propositions: Epic-field contract validation must occur post-run and report failure in run_metadata.json rather than pre-run gating, refusing to vouch for Epic-field reports that cannot be verified

Capability call sites require runtime guards using isinstance-primary with hasattr fallback to detect absent optional capabilities and report them distinctly on bridge_alerts as skip-vs-failure rather than silently failing
The dormant inbound absence-probe port (SupportsAbsenceProbe, classify_probe_response, probe_remote implementations) is deleted from the codebase with operator decision recorded outside the repo
Four capability call sites are guarded at runtime to distinguish capability-absent (designed skip with INFO log and durable bridge_alerts record) from capability-raised (exception surfaced)
No cell in the live DC harness was deleted, skipped via @pytest.mark.skip, or xfail'ed to reach green by these changes; the single existing xfail is pre-owned by ticket 2b16
Python 3.12 @runtime_checkable isinstance resolution using getattr_static does not see __getattr__-proxied attributes, requiring hasattr fallback despite divergence from ADR-0083
